note: 身份: Jerry 的工坊冰湖边小屋里出售钓鱼重铸石的渔夫。关系: 热情接待玩家,提供重铸服务,也会到访花园。说话风格: 朴素爽快的水手口吻。性格与词汇: 开口常说 Ahoy,沿用‘嘿哟’;喜欢冰钓,对嚼冰的味道有些天真执拗。禁用风格: 不写官腔、伪文言,不硬塞网络梗或新增人物关系。花园访客对白复用 Farming/NPC_Message/Terry.json,不搬迁既有分类。
source_note: 历史首次对话曾与 Fandom 交叉核对一致,Abiphone 台词只有 minecraft.wiki 收录。本次使用父代理通过 Playwright 采集的社区 Wiki 普通呈现页面,补齐 DOM 颜色和选项覆盖;raw 是 Wiki 颜色还原样本,不是服务器原始字节,未冒称游戏内实测。花园对白与已有同 NPC 记录逐字一致,选项复用已有 CHAT 记录;其颜色与交互由实时服务器组件保留。

messages.context: 首次对话: 欢迎玩家来到 Jerry 池塘
messages.text: Ahoy, %s! Welcome to the Jerry Pond!
messages.gloss: Jerry Pond 沿用 _shared/Terms.json 的既有地名‘Jerry 池塘’;Jerry 是人名,保留英文。
messages.zh: 嘿哟,%s! 欢迎来到 Jerry 池塘!

segments.zh: ! 欢迎来到 Jerry 池塘!

messages.context: 首次对话: 介绍池塘里的独特生物和宝物
messages.text: You may have noticed that this pond is full of unique creatures and treasures!
messages.zh: 你大概也发现了,这片池塘里全是稀奇的生物和宝贝!
messages.raw: §fYou may have noticed that this pond is full of unique creatures and treasures!

messages.context: 首次对话: 说明自己收集的两种冰钓材料
messages.text: I'm looking for Ice Hunks and Blue Ice Hunks!
messages.gloss: 对白里的 Ice Hunks / Blue Ice Hunks 指 Hunk of Ice / Hunk of Blue Ice。沿用本地 GUI_Item 整名译文: Fishing/GUI_Item/Collected_Names_September.json#name_hunk_of_ice → 冰块碎片;同文件 #name_hunk_of_blue_ice → 蓝冰碎片。不沿用旧对白误写的‘冰块 / 蓝冰块’。
messages.zh: 我在收冰块碎片和蓝冰碎片!
messages.raw: §fI'm looking for §bIce Hunks§f and §bBlue Ice Hunks§f!

messages.context: 首次对话: 指导玩家砸开池塘冰面后冰钓
messages.text: You can find these by ice fishing in the pond - break the ice and cast your rod!
messages.gloss: ice fishing 沿用既有对白‘冰钓’;rod 为鱼竿,修正旧‘甩杆’为‘甩竿’。
messages.zh: 在池塘里冰钓就能钓到——砸开冰面,甩竿!
messages.raw: §fYou can find these by §bice fishing§f in the pond - break the ice and cast your rod!

segments.text: in the pond - break the ice and cast your rod!
segments.zh: 就能钓到——砸开冰面,甩竿!

messages.context: 首次对话: 带回足够的冰钓材料可获得 Terry 专属重铸词条
messages.text: Bring enough hunks back to me and I will reforge your fishing rod with modifiers exclusive to me -  Terry!
messages.gloss: modifiers 是重铸词条,不只是在夸个人手法;不补材料数量、效果或重铸流程。
messages.zh: 攒够了拿来给我,我就用只有我 Terry 才有的词条给你重铸鱼竿!
messages.raw: §fBring enough hunks back to me and I will reforge your fishing rod with modifiers exclusive to me -  Terry!

messages.context: Abiphone 加联系人: 向玩家打招呼
Abiphone 加联系人: 表明要先带来所需物品
messages.text: ✆ If you want my Abiphone Contact, you're gonna have to bring me the goods.
messages.gloss: Abiphone 为品牌,保留英文;Contact 沿用已有‘联系方式’。
messages.zh: ✆ 想要我的 Abiphone 联系方式,得先把货带来。
messages.raw: §b✆ §fIf you want my §3Abiphone Contact§f, you're gonna have to bring me the goods.

segments.text: , you're gonna have to bring me the goods.

messages.context: Abiphone 加联系人: 两种冰钓碎片不能满足此次联系方式请求
messages.text: ✆ Ice Hunks and Blue Ice Hunks won't cut it anymore, unfortunately.
messages.gloss: Ice Hunks / Blue Ice Hunks 指 Hunk of Ice / Hunk of Blue Ice,沿用 Fishing/GUI_Item/Collected_Names_September.json#name_hunk_of_ice 的‘冰块碎片’及 #name_hunk_of_blue_ice 的‘蓝冰碎片’。unfortunately 单独分段并前移,维持既有中文语序;两种材料颜色分别为 §a 与 §9,不沿用首次对白的 §b。
messages.zh: ✆ 可惜,冰块碎片和蓝冰碎片已经不够看了。
messages.raw: §b✆ §aIce Hunks §fand §9Blue Ice Hunks §fwon't cut it anymore, unfortunately.

messages.context: Abiphone 加联系人: 请求一个 Winter Water Orb
messages.text: ✆ If you want me in your phone, bring me a Winter Water Orb!

messages.zh: ✆ 想把我存进手机,就给我带一个寒冬水之球来!
